name: Qualia
positioning: Title and escrow production software where the lender, the agent and the buyer work inside the same closing file.
description: Qualia is a title, escrow and closing platform: order management and title production, escrow accounting and reconciliation, document generation, a secure portal for all parties, remote online notarisation and digital closings, plus a marketplace of title services.
real_estate_use: A US closing coordinates a title agent, a lender, two brokerages and a buyer, historically through email and fax. Qualia gives them one file: the buyer uploads identity documents and wiring instructions through a secure portal — which is also the main defence against wire fraud, the industry's most expensive failure — and escrow accounting reconciles inside the same system.
features: Title order management and production workflow
Secure multi-party closing portal with document exchange
Wire fraud protection and verified wiring instructions
Remote online notarisation and digital closing
Marketplace for title search and settlement services

use_cases.job: Run title production and escrow accounting in one auditable system
Track a closing file and its outstanding conditions without email chains
